Subject: AuroraTech onboarding: initial docs needed

Hi Lina —

Thanks for choosing Redwood. To put AuroraTech on our vendor roster and issue a PO, procurement needs a couple of items from your side: a Certificate of Insurance (COI) naming Redwood Inference as an additional insured and waiver of subrogation, a completed W-9 (vendor tax form), and the vendor onboarding questionnaire (I attached a short checklist link below).

If you can send the COI and W-9 today we can expedite creation of the PO. One specific ask from legal: the endorsement should include our legal name (Redwood Inference, Inc.) and the following address line: 201 S Market St, San Jose, CA 95113.

Next steps we will take after receipt: confirm insurance limits, queue PO for reviewer, and route to Finance for final approval.

Thanks —
Aisha Rahman
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: onboarding-checklist.pdf (form stub)

Thanks Lina — attaching below the specific endorsement language Legal prefers. No special policy number format required; the broker just needs Redwood named as Additional Insured with the waiver.

Endorsement wording (please have broker confirm exact phrasing):
"Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors and employees are included as Additional Insured with respect to liability arising out of the operations of the named insured. Waiver of subrogation is granted in favor of Redwood Inference, Inc."

Once we have the COI with that endorsement and the W-9 we’ll create the PO and route it to Finance. Lina — when you send the W-9 can you also include AuroraTech’s remit-to and the legal entity name exactly as it should appear on the PO?

Thanks,
